entities.summary: Bukki, a renowned entrepreneur of the Classical era, played a pivotal role in shaping the global landscape of commerce and religion. Born around 500 BCE in ancient Babylon, Bukki rose to prominence as a skilled mediator and strategist, facilitating trade agreements between rival city-states and empires. His innovative approaches to conflict resolution and diplomacy earned him a reputation as a master of negotiations, and his influence extended across the Mediterranean world. Bukki's legacy can be seen in the establishment of the first global trade federation, which promoted economic cooperation and cultural exchange among nations. The Bukki Institute, a prestigious think tank, continues to honor his memory and promote his ideas on international relations and conflict resolution. As Bukki once said, 'A strong economy is the foundation of a strong society.'
